title: nfl.com publishes no spreads, totals or moneylines
detail: The league's official site carries no betting prices, and no operator publishes a public, machine-readable, timestamped price history. Gate G2 cannot pass for any strategy.
consequence: Closing-line value, ROI at a real price, and demotion triggers D1a/D1b/D1f are unmeasurable.
action: Capture an operator price page on a fixed schedule, or accept that no strategy can ever be certified.

title: The pinned mirror lags the official results feed
detail: Of 137 official 2026 finals, the mirror agrees on 136 and disagrees on 0; 1 game is final on nfl.com but unscored in the mirror.
consequence: Any desk reading scores from the mirror is up to several days behind.
action: Keep nfl.com as the results source of record and treat the mirror as a cross-check only.

title: MODEL_CLOSE is not yet observed for any market
detail: The store records the desk's origination price; its close-out price can only exist once the pipeline re-runs closer to kickoff.
consequence: We cannot measure how far our own line moves between origination and kickoff.
action: Schedule the pipeline to re-run a few hours before kickoff and write a second MODEL row.

title: The Week 11 official injury report is not published yet
detail: Requesting the Week 11 URL returns the Week 10 report; the report needed to price Week 11 does not exist.
consequence: Every Week 11 market is originated with no injury or replacement-depth adjustment.
action: Re-run the pipeline once the league publishes the Week 11 report.

title: Depth charts are one club short and one day old
detail: 31 of 32 clubs publish a readable depth chart. Houston publishes its chart only as a raster image, so it contributes no rows rather than a guessed set.
consequence: Houston's replacement depth is unknown; any club that edited its chart after the snapshot is stale.
action: Re-fetch weekly and fail closed (blank plus flag) for clubs without machine-readable charts.

title: No player-prop lines exist from any source in this repo
detail: Neither nfl.com nor the mirror publishes player-prop lines. The prop-combo family produced no graded bets and gate G7 cannot be satisfied for any parlay or prop combination.
consequence: Two of the three bet classes in the brief cannot be priced at all.
action: Source prop lines with timestamps, or keep the prop family as an explicit unpriceable entry.

title: The totals model does not beat a naive league-average baseline
detail: Out-of-sample on 2026 weeks 5-10: totals MAE 11.0038 against 11.0235 for predicting the league average every game.
consequence: Half of the origination chain adds no forecast value; the moneyline inherits that.
action: Rebuild the totals model before trusting any total or moneyline (S-02).

title: The certification universe is far smaller than gate G1 requires
detail: The official feed holds 137 games; each family produced 4-51 graded bets against a 300-bet minimum.
consequence: Nothing on the certification board can be certified this season, whatever its hit rate.
action: Accumulate seasons of official results, or lower G1 explicitly and record the risk.

title: Home-field advantage is not distinguishable from zero this season
detail: The margin model fits home-field advantage at ~0.21 points per game on 130 non-neutral 2026 games; another desk measured +0.47 with a 95% interval of -1.81 to +2.75.
consequence: A rule leaning on home advantage is leaning on a number we cannot separate from noise.
action: Add a confidence interval and prefer multi-season fits (S-04).

title: Most official injury rows carry no game status at retrieval
detail: The Week 10 report lists 326 players; only 25 carry a game status (14 Out, 11 Questionable).
consequence: The replacement-depth tracker can only use practice status for the other 301 players.
action: Re-read the report on Friday and Saturday; the tracker keys off game status.

title: Every correlation previously published in this repo is inadmissible
detail: The brief requires correlations from officially sourced numbers only. Prior desks computed theirs from the nflverse mirror; those values are moved to a withheld register.
consequence: The correlations published here are fewer and narrower than before.

title: The aggregator reference line has no timestamp
detail: The mirror supplies one line per game per market with no snapshot time; it is neither an opening nor a closing price.
consequence: Any 'we beat the line by X' statement against it could be measuring a stale early-week price.
action: Do not quote a CLV against it; use it only as a difference column.
